title: STORM CORRIDOR // RAIN FADE
historicalBasis: Odisha Super Cyclone (05B) & Cyclone Fani, Bay of Bengal. Calibrated using NOAA IBTrACS tropical cyclone track archive and IMD (India Meteorological Department) Doppler radar outage and microwave rain-fade records. Catastrophic 260 km/h winds and >150 mm/hr precipitation inducing 30 dB UHF path loss.
syntheticDisclaimer: Command entities, scenario injects, and tactical units are synthetic training constructs.

environment.weatherDescription: Category 5 Super Cyclonic Storm eyewall crossing Paradip coast; 260 km/h sustained gusts, catastrophic sea surge, extreme rain attenuation.

events.message: Routine telemetry: AWS-04 pressure reading 965 hPa, barometric pressure falling steadily.

payload.content: AWS-04 automated telemetry: Central pressure 965 hPa, sustained wind 75 knots, wave height 4.2m.

events.message: NOAA / IMD Ingress Alert: Category 5 eyewall strikes coastal corridor; torrential deluge exceeding 160 mm/hr.
SEVERE RAIN FADE: Extreme liquid water droplet density causes 28 dB attenuation on tactical UHF frequencies. 60% packet drop.
Coast Guard Rescue Unit Bravo transmits visual flash report via SatCom.

payload.content: URGENT FIELD DISPATCH: Eastern sea wall breached near Mahanadi rivermouth. 5-meter tidal surge rushing toward coastal hamlet. Low-ground escape routes underwater.

events.message: CONTRADICTION: Automated harbor telemetry claims sea wall sensors register nominal water level, conflicting with Coast Guard visuals.

payload.content: STALE SENSOR: Harbor telemetry registers flood gate water level at normal +0.8m (sensor clogged with mud and silt; failed to report electrical short).

events.message: SATCOM FAILURE: Inmarsat antenna pedestal gimbal severed by 240 km/h wind shear. Geostationary satellite tracking lost.
Cyclone Shelter Sector 7 confirms armored hardwire wire-line connection operational.

payload.content: Shelter Sector 7 direct hardwire secure: Facility structurally sound on high ground with capacity for 2,500 evacuees. Requesting amphibious brigade diversion here.

events.message: Amphibious Evac Brigade patches into hardwire junction box.

payload.content: Connected to hardwire terminal: Low coastal highway submerged by 2.5m surge. Confirming Coast Guard report; diverting all civilians along elevated rail embankment to Shelter 7.

decisionWindows.situation: UHF radio is suffering severe rain-fade packet loss and the Inmarsat satellite mast has collapsed. A clogged automated sensor reports sea walls are intact while Coast Guard Bravo visually confirms a 5-meter surge inundation. You must evaluate sensor vs visual credibility, transition coordination to shielded field hardwire, and redirect evacuation convoys to Shelter 7.
